digest.component_or_area: CLI infrastructure (argparse factories and advanced command dispatch)
propositions: Advanced command grammars (bridge, reconciler, audit, LLM/review, workflow, identity, gate) currently mix inline argparse construction with manual dispatch and must be extracted into S2a side-effect-free factory contracts.
Parser factories must not import optional runtimes (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor, metrics, tracing) and must remain in lean modules.

Argument-definition helpers must be reused across canonical nested bridge forms and compatibility commands (bridge-fsck, bridge-probe, jira-onboard, bridge-status) while preserving prog, visibility, and historical usage behaviors.
All migrated handlers that today catch SystemExit on parse failure must be updated to also catch ParseError and emit identical process exit code (2) and stderr/usage bytes without traceback.
Every advanced route must have a valid registered factory reference and be deterministically S2d-generation-ready with heavy optional modules import-blocked.

Parser unit tests, subprocess/interface tests, and parse-failure parity tests must verify nested selection, help safety, lean-mode availability, and byte-identical help output for commands with custom usage, formatter, or add_help behaviors.
